title: sao.3: feed endpoint integration tests
description:
What: Write integration tests for the feed endpoints in crates/mail/src/server.rs or a new test file.

Oracle: RSS 2.0 spec (rssboard.org), Atom 1.0 RFC 4287 — expected XML structure derived from spec, not from the code under test.

Tests (use the existing spawn_server + reqwest pattern from server.rs test module):

Test 1: feed_rss_returns_xml_for_known_group
  - Pre-condition: post an article to the in-memory stores (use the OverviewStore directly, insert a test OverviewRecord)
  - GET /feed/comp.test.rss
  - Assert: 200 OK
  - Assert: Content-Type contains application/rss+xml
  - Assert: body starts with "<?xml" or contains "<rss"
  - Assert: body contains the group name
  - Assert: body contains the article subject (escaped if needed)
  - Assert: body contains "<item>" element

Test 2: feed_atom_returns_xml_for_known_group
  - Same setup
  - GET /feed/comp.test.atom
  - Assert: 200 OK  
  - Assert: Content-Type contains application/atom+xml
  - Assert: body contains "<feed" and "<entry>"
  - Assert: body contains the article subject

Test 3: feed_invalid_group_name_returns_400
  - GET /feed/../etc/passwd.rss
  - Assert: 400 Bad Request

Test 4: feed_nonexistent_group_returns_empty_feed
  - GET /feed/no.such.group.atom
  - Assert: 200 OK (empty feed, not 404)
  - Assert: Content-Type contains application/atom+xml
  - Assert: body does NOT contain "<entry>"

Test 5: feed_path_without_extension_returns_404
  - GET /feed/comp.test (no .rss or .atom suffix)
  - Assert: 404 Not Found

Test 6: xml_special_chars_are_escaped
  - Insert an article with subject "<XSS>&test\"
  - GET /feed/comp.test.rss
  - Assert: body contains "<XSS>&test" (or equivalent escaped form)
  - Assert: body does NOT contain literal "<XSS>"

Defensive programming:
- Tests must use real OverviewStore (in-memory SQLite via ServerStores::new_mem or direct OverviewStore construction) — not mocked
- Tests must not rely on specific article numbers
- XML escaping test uses independent oracle (HTML entity encoding rules, not the code under test)

Acceptance: all 6 tests pass with cargo test --package usenet-ipfs-mail
